description: Every Syncro PSA and RMM workflow in your terminal, plus a local database, offline search, and cross-entity reports no other Syncro tool has.

novel_features.name: Uninvoiced time
novel_features.description: Find logged-but-unbilled labor across every customer so no billable time slips.

novel_features.name: Invoice drift audit
novel_features.description: Surface tickets closed long ago that have logged time but were never invoiced.

novel_features.name: AR aging report
novel_features.description: Bucket unpaid invoices into 0-30/30-60/60-90/90+ day aging tiers.

novel_features.name: Customer profitability
novel_features.description: Compare logged labor against invoiced revenue per customer over a window.

novel_features.name: SLA aging triage
novel_features.description: List open tickets past SLA with no comment in the last N hours.

novel_features.name: Patch gap sweep
novel_features.description: Rank assets missing critical patches across every customer.

novel_features.name: Alert noise ranking
novel_features.description: Rank customers by RMM alert volume over a time window.

novel_features.name: Alert to ticket orphans
novel_features.description: Surface RMM alerts that never became a ticket within a window.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Diff two retained local sync snapshots across all entities.
